zh.lead: 今天没有新的实验室官方产品发布。更值得先看的是本周主线：Anthropic 完成 IPO 交割，Gemini 4 Neon 登上 CursorBench 4.1 官方榜首，OpenAI 把评测、安全研究和 ChatGPT 客户端更新推到台前。

important.title: 重要消息
items: 本周最大事件仍是 Anthropic 于 11 月 20 日宣布 IPO 完成交割：公开发行 11.27 亿股 A 类股、定价 83.00 美元，公司所得约 916 亿美元，再加向 AMD、博通、Google、美光、微软、NVIDIA 和台积电的定向增发约 260 亿美元，合计约 1,195 亿美元。ANT 已于 11 月 19 日开盘。昨日早报之后，Anthropic、Claude、OpenAI、Google 与 Meta 官方账号未见新的原创帖。
OpenAI 产品账号 Tibo 周六午后写道，团队内部无意中做出一个「太好玩」、大家都在玩而不是干活的体验；今早又说要去看看 ChatGPT 的 threads。这两条都没有正式产品说明，不能写成新功能已经上线。

Sebastian Raschka 发表《The US-China Open-Weight Feedback Loop》，用 2021–2026 的架构时间线说明开源权重模型如何互相借鉴。Simon Willison 记下 Graham Dumpleton 用 AI 辅助重写的 Rust 服务器 Muru，并特别推荐「AI as a lifestyle choice」。alphaXiv 今日第三名换成 Levent Alpöge 与 Claude 合作的黎曼猜想证明声明，作者称论证已形式化，但仍需独立检验。
CursorBench 4.1 较昨日无更新，官方得分仍由 Gemini 4 Neon Extra High（65.4%）领跑，性价比头部仍是 Haiku 5.5 Low。各产品稳定版无新标签，仅 codex 实验线推进到 0.173.0-alpha.4，发布说明几乎只有版本号。

sections.title: 周末的产品信号
sections.body: 实验室官方账号在周六上午之后基本静音。Tibo 的两条新帖互动不低，但都是暗示而不是发布稿：一条说内部体验「太好玩」，一条说要去看 threads。结合本周较早的桌面应用升级和 threads 重建，更宜当成产品侧还在打磨的信号。

sections.title: 博客与论文
sections.body: Raschka 的短文认为，美中开源权重模型一直在互相吸收对方的架构想法，专有模型的能力和价格也受这条开源反馈影响。Simon 的链接帖汇总了 Muru 近三周的开发笔记。alphaXiv 前两名仍是可组合 harness 与反事实 JEPA 世界模型；第三名的黎曼猜想声明热度很高，但还不是已被确认的证明。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: Hermes Agent 稳定版仍为 v0.23.3，OpenClaw 仍为 v2026.11.6（LTS 为 v2026.10.33，实验标签为 v2026.11.10-beta.1），DeepSeek Harness 仍为 dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5。codex 稳定版仍为 0.171.0，实验线到 rust-v0.173.0-alpha.4。Cursor changelog 自 11 月 6 日无新条目。Grok Bot 仍为 v1.2.3，与 Homebrew cask grok-bot 对齐。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: Karpathy、Andrew Ng 和 Claude 官方账号近 36 小时未见原创帖。关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 一手 X。Claude 与 Cursor 产品 changelog 无新条目。

en.lead: There is no new official product launch from the labs today. The more useful frame is the week: Anthropic closed its IPO, Gemini 4 Neon took the official lead on CursorBench 4.1, and OpenAI put evaluations, safety research, and ChatGPT client updates on stage.

important.title: Headlines
items: The week’s biggest event remains Anthropic’s November 20 announcement that its IPO had closed: 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83.00, about $91.6 billion to the company, plus a concurrent private placement to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and TSMC for about $26.0 billion, or about $119.5 billion combined. ANT began trading on November 19. After yesterday’s briefing, the official Anthropic, Claude, OpenAI, Google, and Meta accounts had no new original posts.

OpenAI’s product account Tibo wrote on Saturday afternoon that the team had inadvertently made an internal experience that was a bit too fun, and this morning said he was going to check out ChatGPT’s threads. Neither post is a formal product announcement, so they should not be written up as a shipped feature.

Sebastian Raschka published “The US-China Open-Weight Feedback Loop,” a 2021–2026 architecture timeline of how open-weight models have borrowed from one another. Simon Willison logged Graham Dumpleton’s AI-assisted Rust server Muru and especially recommended “AI as a lifestyle choice.” On alphaXiv, the third slot is now Levent Alpöge’s claimed proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, developed with Claude; the author says the argument has been formalized, but it still needs independent scrutiny.

CursorBench 4.1 is unchanged versus yesterday: Gemini 4 Neon Extra High still leads official scores at 65.4%, and Haiku 5.5 Low still leads on value. No stable product tags moved; Codex’s experimental line only advanced to 0.173.0-alpha.4, with release notes that are little more than the version number.

sections.title: Weekend product signals
sections.body: The official lab accounts went quiet after Saturday morning. Tibo’s two new posts got solid engagement, but both are hints rather than release notes: one about an internal experience that is “too fun,” and one about checking out threads. Read alongside this week’s earlier desktop-app upgrade and thread rebuild, they are better treated as signs that the client is still being polished.

sections.title: Blogs and papers
sections.body: Raschka argues that U.S. and Chinese open-weight models have been absorbing each other’s architectural ideas, and that proprietary models’ quality and price have also been shaped by that loop. Simon’s link post gathers three weeks of Muru development notes. alphaXiv’s top two remain the compositional-harness paper and the counterfactual JEPA world model; the new third-place Riemann claim is getting attention, but it is not a confirmed proof.

sections.title: Products
sections.body: Hermes Agent’s stable release remains v0.23.3, OpenClaw remains v2026.11.6 (LTS v2026.10.33, experimental v2026.11.10-beta.1), and DeepSeek Harness remains dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5. Codex stable remains 0.171.0, with the experimental line at rust-v0.173.0-alpha.4. Cursor’s changelog still has no entry since November 6. Grok Bot remains v1.2.3, matching the Homebrew cask grok-bot.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: Karpathy, Andrew Ng, and the official Claude account had no original posts in the past 36 hours. The watchlist still has no DeepSeek primary X account. The Claude and Cursor product changelogs have no new entries.

title.en: Weekly trend summary (~Nov 16–Nov 22)

summary.zh: 相对上周「主力模型扎堆落地 + 智能体走进支付与会议 + 安全能力产品化」，本周重心转到公司与评测：Anthropic 完成有记录以来规模很大的 IPO 交割，ANT 开盘；Google 的 Gemini 4 Neon 在 11 月 18 日前后成为新的焦点，并在随后升级的 CursorBench 4.1 上以 65.4% 登上官方榜首。OpenAI 则连发 GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol、MedChemBench、对抗性蒸馏研究，并推动 ChatGPT 桌面端与商户 agent 的产品打磨。编码栈上，Hermes 从 v0.23.2 升到 v0.23.3，OpenClaw 连发 11.4 至 11.6，codex 稳定版进到 0.171.0，Grok Bot 从周初的 1.0.1 升到 1.2.3。缺口依旧：关注列表没有 DeepSeek 一手 X；Karpathy、Andrew Ng 和 Claude 官方后半周几乎静音；Cursor changelog 自 11 月 6 日的 Voice Chat 后再无条目。
summary.en: Versus last week’s cluster of flagship-model launches, agents moving into payments and meetings, and security work packaged as products, this week’s center of gravity shifted to the company and to evaluations: Anthropic closed a historically large IPO and ANT began trading; Google’s Gemini 4 Neon became the new focus around November 18 and then took the official lead on the upgraded CursorBench 4.1 at 65.4%. OpenAI shipped GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol, MedChemBench, and research on adversarial distillation, while polishing the ChatGPT desktop app and merchant agents. In the coding stack, Hermes moved from v0.23.2 to v0.23.3, OpenClaw shipped 11.4 through 11.6, Codex stable reached 0.171.0, and Grok Bot moved from 1.0.1 early in the week to 1.2.3. The gaps are familiar: still no DeepSeek primary X on the watchlist; Karpathy, Andrew Ng, and the official Claude account were largely quiet in the second half of the week; Cursor’s changelog has had no entry since Voice Chat on November 6.

label.zh: Anthropic 上市成为本周主线
label.en: Anthropic’s listing became the week’s main story

text.zh: 11 月 19 日 ANT 在纳斯达克开盘；11 月 20 日公司宣布 IPO 完成交割，公开发行 11.27 亿股 A 类股、定价 83.00 美元，公司所得约 916 亿美元，并向 AMD、博通、Google、美光、微软、NVIDIA 和台积电定向增发约 260 亿美元，两项合计约 1,195 亿美元。官方还发布了七位联合创始人的回顾视频。这是公司叙事和资本事件，不是新产品稿，但明显压过了本周后半段的其他动态。
text.en: ANT began trading on Nasdaq on November 19, and on November 20 the company announced that the IPO had closed: 1.127 billion Class A shares at $83.00, about $91.6 billion to the company, plus a concurrent private placement to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and TSMC for about $26.0 billion, or about $119.5 billion combined. It also posted a recap video of its seven co-founders. This is a corporate and capital-markets story, not a product launch, but it clearly overshadowed the rest of the week’s second half.

label.zh: Gemini 4 Neon 接过官方评测榜首，CursorBench 升至 4.1
label.en: Gemini 4 Neon took the official eval lead as CursorBench moved to 4.1

text.zh: 上周 CursorBench 还是 4.0，官方得分由 Gemini 4 Carbon High（60.4%）领跑。本周页面改为 4.1（changelog 日期 11 月 18 日），配置数从 91 个减到 53 个，分数不可与 4.0 直接对比。新榜上 Gemini 4 Neon Extra High 以 65.4% / $10.67 居官方第一，Neon High 63.7% 第二；性价比头部则仍是低成本的 Haiku 5.5。Google 官方账号也在周末回顾了 Neon、Genie 4 和 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe 等近两周进展。
text.en: Last week CursorBench was still 4.0, with Gemini 4 Carbon High (60.4%) leading official scores. This week the page moved to 4.1 (changelog dated November 18), the table shrank from 91 configs to 53, and the scores should not be compared directly with 4.0. On the new board, Gemini 4 Neon Extra High leads official scores at 65.4% / $10.67, with Neon High at 63.7% in second; value is still led by low-cost Haiku 5.5. Google’s official accounts also recapped the last two weeks, including Neon, Genie 4, and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe.

label.zh: OpenAI 把科学评测、安全研究和客户端打磨放在一起推进
label.en: OpenAI pushed science evals, safety research, and client polish together

text.zh: 11 月 17 日发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与更便宜的 Sol，并扩大科研人员资助。11 月 20 日连发 MedChemBench（GPT-6.2 Astra 在 xhigh 设置下 84.5%）和对抗性蒸馏研究（内部评估中，提取受保护推理的攻击成功率从 54.0% 降到 0.2%）。产品侧，Tibo 先是提醒升级桌面应用，并提到 threads 重建；美国以外的电商和线上服务商户也可认证并在 ChatGPT 中发布 agent。周末又出现关于「太好玩」的内部体验和 threads 的暗示，但还没有正式说明。
text.en: On November 17 OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and the cheaper Sol, and expanded its researcher access program. On November 20 it published MedChemBench (GPT-6.2 Astra scored 84.5% at xhigh) and research on adversarial distillation (an internal evaluation showed the attack success rate for recovering protected reasoning falling from 54.0% to 0.2%). On the product side, Tibo urged a desktop-app upgrade and mentioned a thread rebuild, and ecommerce and online-service businesses outside the United States became eligible to claim their business and publish agents in ChatGPT. Over the weekend he also teased a “too fun” internal experience and said he would check out threads, still without a formal note.

label.zh: 编码智能体继续出包，Cursor 产品稿仍停在 11 月 6 日
label.en: Coding agents kept shipping, while Cursor’s changelog stayed on November 6

text.zh: Hermes Agent 本周先有 v0.23.2，再于 11 月 20 日升到稳定版 v0.23.3，汇总约 370 个 PR。OpenClaw 从 v2026.11.4 连发到 v2026.11.6，LTS 仍为 v2026.10.33。codex 稳定版从 0.169.0 一带进到 0.171.0，默认模型改为 GPT-6.2 Sol，并默认启用 TUI workspace；实验线周末到 0.173.0-alpha.4。Grok Bot 官方 changelog 在 11 月 18 日更新为 v1.2.3。相比之下，Cursor 产品 changelog 仍停在 11 月 6 日的 Voice Chat，本周没有新的产品稿。
text.en: Hermes Agent shipped v0.23.2 and then, on November 20, stable v0.23.3, rolling up about 370 PRs. OpenClaw moved from v2026.11.4 through v2026.11.6, with LTS still at v2026.10.33. Codex stable advanced from the 0.169.0 range to 0.171.0, making GPT-6.2 Sol the default catalog model and enabling the TUI workspace by default; the experimental line reached 0.173.0-alpha.4 over the weekend. Grok Bot’s official changelog moved to v1.2.3 on November 18. By contrast, Cursor’s product changelog is still Voice Chat from November 6, with no new product entry this week.

summary.zh: 今早说要去看看 ChatGPT 的 threads。结合本周较早提到的 threads 重建，这更像是产品负责人亲自试用，而不是一条功能发布。
summary.en: This morning he said he was going to check out ChatGPT’s threads. Read with the earlier mention of a thread rebuild this week, it reads more like the product lead trying the feature than like a launch post.

summary.zh: 写道团队内部无意中做出一个「太好玩」的体验，大家都在玩而不是干活，并说「可能缓不过来」。互动很高，但没有说明具体功能，不能当成正式发布。
summary.en: He wrote that the team had inadvertently made an internal experience that was a bit too fun, that everyone was playing instead of working, and that they might not recover. Engagement was high, but he did not describe a feature, so it should not be treated as a formal launch.

title.zh: 美中开源权重模型的反馈循环
title.en: The US-China Open-Weight Feedback Loop

summary.zh: 11 月 21 日，Raschka 用一条 2021–2026 的架构时间线说明：美国和中国的开源权重模型一直在互相吸收对方的想法，例如 LLaMA 采用 RoPE，DeepSeek LLM 采用分组查询注意力，后来的 MoE、MLA、混合注意力和路由方法也在两边往返。他认为，没有这条开源反馈，两边的开源模型不会像现在这样强，专有模型的能力和价格也会不同。文章注明配图只是选集，不是完整清单。
summary.en: On November 21, Raschka used a 2021–2026 architecture timeline to argue that U.S. and Chinese open-weight models have been absorbing each other’s ideas — for example LLaMA adopting RoPE, DeepSeek LLM adopting grouped-query attention, and later MoE, MLA, hybrid attention, and routing methods traveling in both directions. He thinks neither side’s open-weight models would be as strong without that loop, and that proprietary models’ quality and price have been shaped by it too. He notes that the figure is a selection, not a complete list.

caption.zh: Raschka 文中的开源权重模型互相借鉴时间线（已镜像入仓）
caption.en: Timeline figure from Raschka’s note on how open-weight models build on each other (mirrored in-repo)

title.zh: Muru：用 AI 辅助重写的 Python 应用服务器
title.en: Muru: an AI-assisted rewrite of a Python application server

summary.zh: 11 月 21 日，Simon Willison 记下 Graham Dumpleton 的新项目 Muru：这是他在维护 mod_wsgi 二十年之后，用 AI 辅助写成的 Rust 服务器，目标是更好地在开发和生产中运行 ASGI 与 WSGI 应用。Simon 汇总了近三周的开发笔记，并特别推荐 11 月 11 日的「AI as a lifestyle choice」：AI 可以做大量表面工作，但什么还不够好，仍然要由作者判断。
summary.en: On November 21, Simon Willison logged Graham Dumpleton’s new project Muru: a Rust server, written with AI assistance after twenty years of maintaining mod_wsgi, aimed at running ASGI and WSGI apps well in both development and production. Simon gathered three weeks of development notes and especially recommended the November 11 piece “AI as a lifestyle choice”: AI can do much of the surface work, but deciding what is not good enough yet still sits with the author.

title.zh: 语言模型的 Harness 也可以成为可组合的泛化器
title.en: Language Model Harnesses Can Be Compositional Generalizers

summary.zh: Alex L. Zhang、Souradip Chakraborty 和 Omar Khattab 认为，标准 agent harness 会不断堆积上下文，使网络必须对长程任务做昂贵泛化。他们研究把 harness 本身训练成可组合的神经符号泛化器，从而让模型看到的每一步都更接近分布内。文章称，在强化学习后训练下，只在短任务上训练也可泛化到长 2–64 倍的任务，并在共享潜在结构的新领域上迁移。
summary.en: Alex L. Zhang, Souradip Chakraborty, and Omar Khattab argue that standard agent harnesses accumulate context, forcing the network to generalize expensively on long-horizon tasks. They study training the harness itself as a compositional, neurosymbolic generalizer, so that each observation the model sees stays closer to in-distribution. They report that, under RL post-training, training only on short tasks can generalize to tasks 2–64× longer and transfer to new domains that share latent structure.

title.zh: 反事实世界模型：能回答「如果」的 JEPA
title.en: Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About “What If”

summary.zh: Randall Balestriero、Yann LeCun 等人讨论：在不能完全观察的环境里，世界模型如何回答「若采取另一动作、但扰动相同，结果会怎样」。他们证明，只在事实转移上训练的世界模型无法独自回答这个问题；当动作与扰动可视为可分力时，可用观测结果加上两种动作预测之差，在不必收集反事实数据的情况下构造一阶近似。
summary.en: Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun, and coauthors discuss how a world model in a partially observed environment can answer what would have happened under a different action subject to the same hidden disturbance. They prove that a model trained only on factual transitions cannot answer that question on its own; when actions and disturbances act as separate forces, the observed outcome plus the difference between the two predicted actions gives a first-order approximation without counterfactual data.

title.zh: 一份尚未被确认的黎曼猜想证明声明
title.en: A claimed, still-unconfirmed proof of the Riemann Hypothesis

summary.zh: 这篇 11 月 20 日提交的短文介绍 Levent Alpöge 的声明：他与 Claude 合作，提出黎曼猜想与广义黎曼猜想的证明，并称论证已经形式化。摘要写明证明很长，作者还打算继续解释和简化。这是声明而不是已被独立验证的证明，宜保持审慎，不能写成猜想已被解决。
summary.en: This November 20 submission presents Levent Alpöge’s claim that, working with Claude, he has a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, and that the arguments have been formalized. The abstract says the proof is long and that the author intends to explain and simplify it. This is a claim, not an independently verified proof, and should not be written up as a settled result.

sourceName.zh: 水木社区 · 儿童教育版

summary.zh: 今日采集到儿童教育版当前第一页主题（已去掉置顶讨论指南、原帖已删除的条目）。讨论较集中的是分班与普通班、家长会、奥数路径，以及作业、睡眠、练字和兴趣班等日常问题；对涉及未成年人与违规软件的帖子，公开页作了中性改写。
summary.en: Today’s collection covers the current first page of the Child Education board, after dropping the pinned guide and threads whose original posts were deleted. The liveliest discussions are about class assignment versus regular classes, parent-teacher conferences, and contest-math paths, alongside everyday questions on homework, sleep, handwriting, and enrichment classes. Posts involving minors and unapproved software have been neutrally rewritten on the public page.

title.zh: 背完唐诗三百首啦
title.en: Finished memorizing Three Hundred Tang Poems

summary.zh: 楼主分享孩子背完《唐诗三百首》。讨论已到 74 层，今早仍有新回复，交流背诵方法和坚持过程。
summary.en: The original poster shares that a child has finished memorizing Three Hundred Tang Poems. The thread has 74 replies, including a new one this morning, on memorization methods and how they kept going.

title.zh: 其实兴趣班大概率是严重打击娃成就感的重要原因
title.en: Enrichment classes may often undermine a child’s sense of achievement

summary.zh: 楼主认为兴趣班常常打击孩子的成就感。昨晚发帖后已有多条跟帖，讨论兴趣班的负担和利弊。
summary.en: The original poster argues that enrichment classes often undermine a child’s sense of achievement. Several replies since last night discuss the burden and trade-offs of these classes.

title.zh: 一年级数学考两次8x，语文第一次考7x，咋办
title.en: First-grade scores in the 80s for math and 70s for Chinese: what to do?

summary.zh: 楼主为一年级孩子数学两次 80 多分、语文首次 70 多分求助。讨论集中在要不要紧张、以及如何在家里补习。
summary.en: A parent asks what to do after a first grader scored in the 80s on two math tests and in the 70s on a first Chinese test. Replies focus on whether to worry and how to help at home.

title.zh: 据说老师被投诉12345了

summary.en: The original poster says a teacher was reportedly reported through the 12345 hotline. Replies discuss the context and how parents should communicate with the school.

title.zh: 二年级男娃学习总结
title.en: A second-grade boy’s study recap

summary.zh: 楼主分享二年级男孩的学习总结，跟帖已超过 50 层，讨论学习方法、作业节奏和家长怎么配合。
summary.en: The original poster shares a study recap for a second-grade boy. The thread already has more than 50 replies on methods, homework pace, and how parents can help.

title.zh: 五年级语文阅读理解有点欠缺，需要上辅导班吗？
title.en: Fifth-grade reading comprehension is weak: is a tutoring class needed?

summary.zh: 楼主问五年级语文阅读理解要不要上辅导班。跟帖不多，主要在交流是否需要额外补习。
summary.en: A parent asks whether a fifth grader who is weak in Chinese reading comprehension needs a tutoring class. There are only a few replies, mostly on whether extra tutoring is necessary.

title.zh: 北京怎么没有秋假，北京秋天挺舒服的
title.en: Why doesn’t Beijing have an autumn break, when fall is so pleasant?

summary.zh: 楼主讨论北京为何没有秋假。近日仍有跟帖，但讨论规模不大。
summary.en: The original poster asks why Beijing has no autumn break, given how pleasant the season is. A few recent replies keep the thread alive, but discussion remains light.

title.en: Another look at the debate over equations in elementary contest math

summary.zh: 这是去年的旧帖，讨论小学奥数里方程教学的争议。跟帖已到 88 层，昨日仍有新回复。
summary.en: This older thread revisits the debate over teaching equations in elementary contest math. It has 88 replies, with a new one yesterday.

title.zh: 啥时候知道主动学习呢？
title.en: When do children start learning on their own?

summary.zh: 楼主问孩子何时会开始主动学习。跟帖交流如何培养学习内驱力，以及家长该推到什么程度。
summary.en: A parent asks when children start to learn on their own. Replies discuss how to build intrinsic motivation and how hard parents should push.

title.zh: 三年级怎么练字
title.en: How should a third grader practice handwriting?

summary.zh: 楼主请教三年级练字的方法。跟帖给出练习节奏和材料方面的建议。
summary.en: The original poster asks how a third grader should practice handwriting. Replies offer suggestions on practice rhythm and materials.

title.zh: 讨论初中生私下下载违规软件时，家长可以怎么处理
title.en: Parents discuss what to do when a middle-schooler downloads unapproved software

summary.zh: 楼主为初中孩子私下下载违规软件求助。跟帖很多，集中在沟通方式、设备管理和家庭规则，这里不展开软件内容。
summary.en: A parent asks for advice after a middle-school child downloaded unapproved software. The long thread focuses on communication, device management, and family rules; the software itself is not described here.

title.zh: 二三年级孩子几点能睡觉？
title.en: What time should second- and third-graders go to bed?

summary.zh: 楼主问二三年级孩子合适的睡觉时间。跟帖交流作息安排，以及作业负担如何影响睡眠。
summary.en: A parent asks what bedtime is reasonable for second- and third-graders. Replies discuss routines and how homework load affects sleep.

title.zh: 家里有个不争气的孩子，我感觉就像
title.en: A parent vents about a child who seems to be falling short

summary.zh: 楼主表达对孩子学习状态的焦虑。讨论较多，多为家长之间的经验分享和情绪支持。
summary.en: The original poster writes about anxiety over a child’s academic progress. The discussion is substantial and mostly offers fellow parents’ experiences and support.

title.zh: 高知们赞成阳光分班吗
title.en: Do highly educated parents support mixed-ability class assignment?

summary.en: The original poster asks whether highly educated parents support mixed-ability (“sunshine”) class assignment. The thread has more than 200 replies and is one of the week’s hottest topics, with clearly divided views.

title.zh: 如果不分班，学霸就不能是学霸了？

summary.en: This older thread continues the debate on whether high-achieving students can still excel without tracked classes. It had a new reply yesterday and echoes the mixed-ability assignment discussion.

title.zh: 自媒体最近在炒作回家自学
title.en: Social-media accounts have been hyping learning at home

summary.zh: 楼主批评自媒体炒作回家自学。跟帖讨论学校教育与家庭自学之间的取舍，以及这类内容为什么容易传播。
summary.en: The original poster criticizes social-media hype around dropping school for learning at home. Replies discuss the trade-off between school and home learning, and why this content spreads.

title.zh: 我一直觉得普班也挺好
title.en: Ordinary classes can be perfectly fine too

summary.zh: 楼主认为普通班也很好。跟帖呼应近期的分班讨论，交流普通班的实际体验。
summary.en: The original poster argues that ordinary, non-tracked classes can be perfectly fine. Replies connect this to the recent assignment debate and share experiences in regular classes.

title.zh: 这样学奥数行不行
title.en: Is this a workable way to study contest math?

summary.zh: 旧帖讨论这样学奥数是否合适。跟帖很多，昨日仍有更新，涉及学习强度和孩子是否跟得上。
summary.en: This older thread asks whether a particular approach to contest math is workable. It has many replies, including a new one yesterday, on intensity and whether children can keep up.

summary.zh: 楼主纠结要不要对孩子更严格。跟帖讨论家庭教育里松与严的分寸，以及怎样避免把焦虑传给孩子。
summary.en: A parent is unsure about becoming stricter. Replies discuss the balance between looseness and firmness, and how to avoid passing anxiety on to the child.

title.zh: 做题掉坑

title.en: Parent-teacher conference today

summary.zh: 楼主分享家长会见闻，跟帖已超过 300 层，是近期讨论最热闹的帖之一，覆盖成绩反馈、家校沟通和家长焦虑。
summary.en: The original poster shares notes from a parent-teacher conference. With more than 300 replies, it is one of the busiest recent threads, covering grades, school communication, and parental anxiety.

title.zh: 玩游戏就像毒品
title.en: Treating gaming as an addiction risk

summary.zh: 楼主把孩子玩游戏比作成瘾。跟帖较多，讨论游戏时间管理、家庭规则，以及怎样避免简单对抗。
summary.en: The original poster compares a child’s gaming to an addiction risk. The long thread discusses time limits, family rules, and how to avoid turning the issue into a simple fight.

title.zh: 统招是西城好考还是海淀好考
title.en: Is the general admission exam easier in Xicheng or Haidian?

summary.zh: 楼主比较西城和海淀的统招难度。跟帖很少，尚未形成充分讨论。
summary.en: The original poster asks whether the general admission exam is easier in Xicheng or Haidian. There are only a few replies, so the discussion is still thin.

text.zh: 今日重心（周日去敏）：周末以陪伴孩子的课业学习为主，并继续通识课（万维钢思考工具）以及技术学习，包括安全架构基础、harness 工程、RSI/DDD 和 pstack。
text.en: Sunday focus (sanitized): the weekend centers on time with the children and their schoolwork, plus the general-education course (Wanweigang’s thinking tools) and technical study, including security-architecture basics, harness engineering, RSI/DDD, and pstack.
